_comment_execution: Execution visibility — controls whether the browser shows on screen:
"headless": false  →  Visible (Headed) mode — watch tests run in real time
"headless": true   →  Background (Headless) mode — runs silently, no UI

appointment._comment_dynamicDateTime: Optional: override auto-generated values. Set to null or omit to use today/now defaults.
appointment._comment_defaultDurationMinutes: Used to calculate endTime when startTime is provided but endTime is not (unless both are null).
